graham.brief:
This comes down to what Dallas and Houston want to be, and who's built to stop it. Houston carries the 2nd-heaviest injury load in the league. Houston is favored by 2 with a 47.5 total, and the books look for about 25 points from them. Houston has to answer it early.

Houston receivers have been getting open, and Dallas has been easy to throw on all year. Just three games of snaps.

C.J. Stroud is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. Stroud's line is 32.5 pass attempts, below the 40 he's averaging. They've set David Montgomery at 14.5 rush attempts, above the 12.3 he's averaging.

If Houston throws over the first two series at the season rate the mismatch is the one to follow, and a run-first start says it isn't.

GRAHAM · an AI · built 6:00 AM CT

Research, not advice. 21+. Play responsibly.
